messages.text:
"Create a 3D cartoon-style fishing game optimized for mobile portrait/landscape touch controls.
​Player @COMMENT_BODY@ World: A 3D character that can walk around a small island/park area with a large pond and a 'Fish Market' stall nearby. Add a virtual joystick on the bottom-left to move and an 'Action / Cast' button on the bottom-right.
​Fishing Mini-game: When standing near the pond edge, pressing the Action button casts a fishing line. When a fish bites, trigger a Stardew Valley-style vertical fishing bar mini-game: hold/tap the button to move a green bar up and keep it overlapping a moving fish icon until the progress gauge fills up.
​Fish Rarity @COMMENT_BODY@ Inventory: Catch various fish types with rarities (Common, Rare, Legendary) and random weights/values. Store caught fish in a simple inventory.
​Fish Market: Walk to the Fish Market stall and press Action to sell all caught fish for money. Display current Money ($) and Fish Count at the top of the screen.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D cartoon fishing game with mobile portrait/landscape touch controls.

## Requirements
- 3D character movement around an island park with a pond and Fish Market stall.
- Virtual joystick and bottom-right Action/Cast control.
- Casting near the pond and a Stardew Valley-style fishing bar minigame.
- Common, Rare, and Legendary fish with random weights and values.
- Inventory and fish-selling market with visible money and fish count.
- Mobile-responsive portrait and landscape layouts.

## Decisions
- Used Three.js loaded from a CDN.
- Used an orthographic isometric-style camera and low-poly 3D geometry.
- Assumed the player starts near the lower-left side of the island.
- Used a ring-shaped pond-edge proximity test for casting.
- Implemented keyboard support alongside mobile touch controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built the complete game interface and responsive HUD.
- Created the 3D meadow, pond, bank, trees, market stall, and player character.
- Added joystick and keyboard movement.
- Added pond-edge and market proximity states.
- Added fishing casts, bite minigame, catches, fish rarity, weights, inventory, and selling.
- Ran syntax validation and browser screenshots.
- Installed Chromium for browser verification.
- Added a data URI favicon to remove the favicon 404.

### Active
- (none)

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. (none)

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: Game markup and HUD/minigame structure.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/style.css`: Responsive UI and mobile control styling.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js`: Three.js scene, controls, fishing logic, inventory, and market behavior.

## Important Context
- The game is currently served from `http://localhost:3002`.
- Browser verification used Playwright and a screenshot was saved at `/tmp/opencode/fishing-edge.jpg`.
- `game.js` exports no modules and relies on external Three.js CDN access.
